Determine how the dual cone C_i^∨ is related to the Λ_i-truncated moment problem, where one asks whether a truncated multisequence indexed by Λ_i admits a non-negative Borel representing measure.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix integers $n \geq 0$, $d \geq 1$, and $k \geq n$. Let $I_{n+1,2d} = \{\alpha \in \mathbb{N}_0^{n+1} : |\alpha| = 2d\}$ be the set of exponents of monomials of degree $2d$ in $n+1$ variables, and enumerate the elements of $I_{n+1,d} = \{\alpha \in \mathbb{N}_0^{n+1} : |\alpha| = d\}$ as $\alpha_0, \alpha_1, \alpha_2, \ldots$ in some fixed order, where $|I_{n+1,d}| = \binom{n+d}{d}$.

For a finite set $\Lambda \subseteq \mathbb{N}_0^{n+1}$, the $\Lambda$-truncated moment problem asks: given a real multisequence $(y_\alpha)_{\alpha \in \Lambda}$, when does there exist a non-negative Borel measure $\mu$ on $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ (or on a prescribed support set) such that
$$y_\alpha = \int X^\alpha \, d\mu(X) \qquad \text{for all } \alpha \in \Lambda?$$

Suppose that, in a fixed Gram-matrix style construction, one has a nested family of closed convex cones
$$\mathrm{SOS}_{n+1,2d} = C_{k-n} \subseteq C_{k-n-1} \subseteq \cdots \subseteq C_0 \subseteq \mathrm{PSD}_{n+1,2d}$$
inside the space of real forms of degree $2d$ in $n+1$ variables, together with their dual cones $C_i^\vee$ (with respect to the standard apolar/coefficient pairing).

For each $i \in \{0, 1, \ldots, k-n\}$, define
$$\Lambda_i := \{\alpha_s + \alpha_t : 0 \leq s, t \leq n+i\} \subseteq I_{n+1,2d} \subseteq \mathbb{N}_0^{n+1}.$$

Problem: Describe explicitly the relationship between the dual cone $C_i^\vee$ and the $\Lambda_i$-truncated moment problem; in particular, characterize membership of a multisequence $(y_\alpha)_{\alpha \in \Lambda_i}$ in (a suitable projection of) $C_i^\vee$ in terms of the existence of a representing non-negative Borel measure for $(y_\alpha)_{\alpha \in \Lambda_i}$.
artifact.category_tag: truncated moment problem and SOS cones
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicitly listed open problem in a 2024 work titled "Separating Cones defined by Toric Varieties: Some Properties and Open Problems." No subsequent work resolving the specific link between the cone filtration $C_i^\vee$ and the $\Lambda_i$-truncated moment problem was found.

status_evidence.title: Separating Cones defined by Toric Varieties: Some Properties and Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Paper introduces a cone filtration between SOS and PSD forms via toric/Veronese constructions and lists open problems including relating dual cones to truncated moment problems.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is explicitly stated as an open problem in this 2024 preprint.
